findings: Revision 1 defines semantic equivalence and an executable E2 conformance procedure.
The architecture recommendation is falsifiable rather than merely descriptive.
conditions: E2 must compare canonical semantic cuts, facts, derived tuples, policy visibility, provenance, proof traces, and admission outcomes.
Operational metadata exclusions must be schema-defined rather than ad hoc.
Hostile duplication, reordering, loss, replay, restart, invalid-envelope, and forged-advertisement cases must be fail-capable.
E3/E4 advancement must bind exact evidence revisions.
residual_uncertainty: Performance acceptability and interface survival under real distributed load remain empirical questions.
